description: Twenty pages of real handwriting, one per writer of the published test split of UJI Pen Characters (Version 2), four sentences each, no planted mistake. The pages scored on vahinitech.com's tested-on-real-handwriting page.
sentences: vahini and bheema write letters every day
pihu sings while tara reads a story
chinnu keeps each word neat and clear
the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
seetha and rama practise slowly with care
vidhya draws big round letters on the line
